context: Extend the learner's mastered set-based precision/recall/F1 to RANKED retrieval: P@k/R@k, AP/MAP, MRR, nDCG (what changes when ranking and graded relevance enter). Frame test collections as "build your own golden query set" for production reuse (regression canaries return in DE 401). Include LLM-as-relevance-judge uses and failure modes; MS MARCO/BEIR descriptively.
